title.zh: Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin puts 60% odds on a cryptography breakthrough that could weaken Wall Street middlemen
title.en: Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin puts 60% odds on a cryptography breakthrough that could weaken Wall Street middlemen

current_state.zh: Vitalik Buterin estimates a 60% chance that SNARKs, FHE, and iO will run at under 10 times ordinary computation cost, potentially enabling private shared-state applications and reducing the need for custodians and clearinghouses.
current_state.en: Vitalik Buterin estimates a 60% chance that SNARKs, FHE, and iO will run at under 10 times ordinary computation cost, potentially enabling private shared-state applications and reducing the need for custodians and clearinghouses.
